name: streamdeck-agent-cockpit
description: Turn a Stream Deck into a standalone local cockpit for Claude Code, Codex, Pi, JCode, and other terminal agents: launch, focus, resume, and interrupt named sessions with evidence-backed status. Use when wiring hardware controls to local agent sessions.
